requirement: v3.3.12: machines whose platform is missing/unknown must be grouped as Web端 even when an older host runtime reports kind=client; the observed 3.3.11 behaviour came from a DSH host started before the install plus a stale client bundle

assertions.whitelist: targetMachineKind returns client only for os in {windows,macos,darwin,win32}; everything else (empty, 'unknown', 'freebsd', linux) is web
assertions.stale_host: the browser classifier derives from os/name and deliberately ignores machine.kind, so a host runtime older than the bundle cannot pin unknown-platform machines to 客户端
assertions.visible_reason: online machines with no platform render 未知平台 in the detail line instead of pretending they are online with no further detail
assertions.runtime_evidence: DSH main process started 2026-11-15 09:16:44 while profile was updated to 3.3.9/3.3.10/3.3.11 later, so the live host was older than the installed package — a full restart is required to load the host half
assertions.proof: fleet-target + client-bundle 100 pass; loader-entry 10/10; claims/layer-model 71 pass; eslint 0 errors
assertions.queue_selfheal: an all-empty main journal is healed at host mount from the newest non-empty draft/queue per session in composer-journal-history.jsonl, with a .bak-recovered-* backup; the live journal was healed (2 drafts + 4 queues) after the 清空全部-style wipe
